I don't know the default for a `--max-retries` flag on `promptfoo eval`. The retrieved documents don't mention such a flag.

The closest material concerns provider-level `maxRetries` config, not a CLI flag:

- "Provider-level retry (scheduler): Retries `callApi()` with 1-second base backoff, up to 3 times by default." [promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/rate-limits.md]
- "HTTP-level retry: Retries failed HTTP requests. Defaults to 4 retries, or the provider's `maxRetries` when set." [promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/rate-limits.md]

The docs do list `promptfoo eval --retry-errors`, which re-runs ERROR results from the latest eval, but that is a different option and has no numeric default. [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]

To confirm whether `--max-retries` exists, check `promptfoo eval --help` or the CLI source.
